Monocypher 4.0.3, by Loup Vaillant, Michael Savage and Fabio Scotoni
https://monocypher.org
https://monocypher.org/download/monocypher-4.0.3.tar.gz
(sha512 40904ada5c7ee4f7741733e38b69a30a4b0561cbffba5ffe7c2dce16136d5402
        51ec0d9056ff606510d3b5b708fb8a40db7e0870d4a0b2dc17ba2bfb880f8965)

monocypher.c and monocypher.h are the release's src/ folder, and
monocypher-ed25519.c and monocypher-ed25519.h its src/optional/ folder,
unchanged. Bedrock checks with it that a plugin is signed by Ravaxx
(Ed25519) before it runs it (src/Plugins.cpp).
